newsitem.title: USA: SIOUX FALLS CATTLE STEADY - UPDATE - USDA.
newsitem.headline: SIOUX FALLS CATTLE STEADY - UPDATE - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady and not well tested on a small midweek supply. - USDA
Slaughter Steers: Part load Choice 3 Blacks near 1300 lbs 67.00. High Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 64.50-66.00. Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 63.50-64.50. Select 1-2 62.50-63.50.
Slaughter Heifers: Scarce, few High Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1125 lbs 64.50-65.75, **few head 66.50.** Select and Choice 2-3950-1100 lbs 63.50-64.50. Select 1-2 61.50-63.50.
